title: Babul Hawaij Haider Dah Laal Ay
body:
Babul Hawaij Haider Dah Laal Ay Paykar Wafa Da Mola Abbas Ay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zahra Da Sadqa Sun Lay Duawan, Dukhiya Di Mola Teray Tay Aas Ay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Teray Alaam Toh Millni Shifawana, Tu Taliyan Nay Mola Qazawan (x2)
Deway Tu Bachray Mawan Nu Mola Nahi Talda Ay Teri Khuda Ay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Teray Tay Raazi Hay Pakh Zahra, Mamnon Teray Imam Barah (x2)
Manzoor Kaarlay Tu Saab Duawan Haar Matami Di Teray Tay Aas Ay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Mushkil Khusha Tu Hajat Rawa Tu Vich Shaam Zainab Di Rayhi Sada Tu (x2)
Ahbad Kaar Day Haar Khaali Jholi Teray Alaam Vich Asghar Di Pyaas Ay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Maqrooz Jera Vi Hay Molayi, Kaar Usdi Mola Mushkil Kushayi (x2)
Sadqa Sakina Da Mola Ghazi Kaar Mominah Di Hajat Rawa Ay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hum Shakal Haider Doja Ali Ay, Haider Day Vangon Shair-e-jaali Ay (x2)
Tu Kibriya Ay Mola Wafa Da, Tenu Dua Tay Zahra Di Khaas Ay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis Nu Vi Chahwain Daywa Badshahi, Tera Alam Hay Deway Gawahi (x2)
Aj Vi Buland Hay Parcham Hay Tera Jo Pyaasayan Day Ghum Vich Udaas Ay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Johar Diyan Sun Mola Duawan, Haar Waqt Devay Aho Sadawan (x2)
Karbobala Di Dharti Tay Mola Kham Khawar Tera Paye Qaza Ay.
